changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencountervaccination AS SELECT ev.id, ev.patient_id, ev.encounter_id, ev.vaccine_id, ev.vaccine_brand_id, ev.vaccine_dose_id, ev.vaccine_lot_number, ev.date_administered, ev.status, ev.cancellation_reason, ev.cancelled_at, ev.cancelled_by, ev.administered_location, ev.administration_reactions, ev.is_external_facility, ev.external_facility_name, ev.notes, ev.created_by, ev.created_date, ev.last_modified_by, ev.last_modified_date, ev.reviewed_at, ev.reviewed_by FROM public.encounter_vaccination ev;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencountervaccination TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencountervaccination FROM report_user;
